tools.name: add_watchlist_alert
tools.description: Add a price or RSI alert for a symbol

tools.name: analyze_concall_sentiment
tools.description: D4 Concall NLP — extract management tone, key themes, risk flags, and sentiment from the most recent earnings call or investor day transcript. Returns: sentiment (Bullish/Cautious/Bearish/Neutral), tone score (-1 to +1), top themes, risk flags, key management quotes, guidance summary. Use for: post-results management tone check, earnings quality assessment, concall digest, what management said about margins/growth/guidance.
tools.doc_summary: D4 Concall NLP — extract management tone, key themes, and sentiment from the most recent earnings call / investor day transcript for a stock.

tools.name: analyze_document
tools.description: Read and extract text from a local file (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT, CSV) or a web URL. Use this for document analysis — annual reports, research papers, filings, concall transcripts, presentations, dashboards. Returns full text content with metadata. For PDFs: page-by-page extraction with automatic vision/OCR fallback for image-only or scanned pages. For DOCX: paragraphs + tables. For HTML: heading sections + tables via BeautifulSoup. For URLs: smart web scraping or PDF download.

source.description: File path (local PDF/DOCX/TXT) or URL (http/https web page or PDF link)

max_pages.description: Max pages to read for PDFs (default 50)

vision_fallback.description: If true, pages with little extractable text are re-transcribed via OpenAI vision (default true).

tools.doc_summary: Read and extract text from a local file (PDF, DOCX, HTML, TXT, CSV) or a web URL.

tools.name: analyze_mtf
tools.description: Multi-timeframe (MTF) technical analysis for a single NSE stock. Computes RSI/MACD/EMA20/EMA50/SMA stack across monthly, weekly, daily, 60m, 15m, produces a weighted confluence score (0-100) and a deterministic BUY/WATCH/AVOID/SELL verdict with per-timeframe rationale. Missing timeframes are reported, never inferred. Use for: 'multi timeframe analysis of X', 'MTF view on X', 'are weekly/daily aligned on X', 'is X a confluent buy'.

timeframes.description: Subset of timeframes to analyse; defaults to all five.

days.description: Daily history depth in days (default 800 ≈ 3 years).

tools.doc_summary: Aligned multi-timeframe analysis for a single symbol.

tools.name: analyze_options_buying
tools.description: Deep options buying analysis for a symbol. Returns ATM IV + regime (cheap/fair/rich), IV rank estimate, expected move (±1σ/±2σ), strike selection guide (ITM/ATM/OTM with delta/theta/breakeven/probability), theta decay profile, OI context, and buying verdict (BUY / USE SPREAD / AVOID). Use for: 'should I buy calls on X', 'best strike to buy', 'options buying setup for X', 'what call should I buy', 'options trade idea for X', 'options opportunity for X'.
tools.doc_summary: Deep options buying analysis for a symbol. Returns: ATM IV + regime, IV rank (estimated), expected move, strike selection guide (ITM/ATM/OTM with delta/theta/breakeven/probability), theta decay profile, OI support/resistance context, buying verdict (BUY / SPREAD / AVOID). direction: 'bullish' | 'bearish' | 'volatile'

tools.name: analyze_youtube_channel_latest
tools.description: Select a preset YouTube market channel by number/name/id, fetch its latest video, then analyze metadata/captions. Speech-to-text is opt-in with transcribe=true.
tools.signature: (selection: 'str | int', persist: 'bool' = True, max_segments: 'int' = 12, transcribe: 'bool' = False, transcription_backend: 'str' = 'local') -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tools.name: analyze_youtube_video
tools.description: Analyze a YouTube market video from metadata and available captions. Audio speech-to-text is attempted only when transcribe=true. Never returns the full transcript.
tools.signature: (source: 'str', persist: 'bool' = True, max_segments: 'int' = 12, transcribe: 'bool' = False, transcription_backend: 'str' = 'local') -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tools.name: apply_revision_round
tools.description: Apply Research Council revision and convergence rules to a serialized CouncilState.
tools.doc_summary: Apply Research Council convergence/revision rules.

tools.name: assess_user_situation
tools.description: Assess what the user is asking, prior context needs, resolved entities, evidence plan, and clarification needs before routing.
tools.doc_summary: Return the v2 situation-assessment contract used before routing.

tools.name: audit_company_search
tools.description: Audit company evidence search attempts with source group, query, result count, parse status, and gaps.
tools.doc_summary: Audit company evidence search attempts in a deterministic source order.

tools.name: audit_postgres_coverage
tools.description: Audit PostgreSQL table existence and row-count coverage for market, intraday, scores, and report data.

tools.name: build_evidence_matrix
tools.description: Build a semantic evidence matrix from executed tool results by category.
tools.doc_summary: Group executed tool evidence by semantic category.

tools.name: build_research_evidence_pack
tools.description: Build a Research Council evidence pack from PostgreSQL-backed market, sector, stock, F&O, fundamentals, events, and report sources.
tools.doc_summary: Build the Research Council evidence pack from PostgreSQL-backed sources.

tools.name: check_watchlist_alerts
tools.description: Check all alerts against live prices/RSI and fire macOS notifications for triggered ones

tools.name: compare_reports
tools.description: Compare two generated reports and highlight recommendation changes.
tools.signature: (first_path: 'str', second_path: 'str', project_root: 'str | Path | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tools.name: compare_stocks
tools.description: Compare multiple NSE stocks SIDE-BY-SIDE on both technical AND fundamental metrics. Technical: stage (Weinstein 1-4), RSI, Relative Strength %, technical score, investment score, trading signal (BUY/SELL/HOLD), trend, supertrend, 1d/1w/1m returns. Fundamental (from screener.in): P/E, P/B, ROE, ROCE, dividend yield, market cap, book value. Returns a comparison_table dict and full stock_details list with pros/cons/narrative. Use for: 'compare X vs Y', 'X vs Y vs Z', 'which is better: X or Y', 'peer comparison', 'compare IT stocks', 'TCS vs INFY', 'rank by ROE'.

aspects.description: What to compare. Default is both.

tools.doc_summary: Compare multiple NSE stocks side-by-side on technical AND fundamental metrics.

tools.name: compose_plan
tools.description: Compose the deterministic Research Council evidence plan for an objective.
tools.doc_summary: Compose a deterministic Research Council evidence plan.

tools.name: comprehensive_stock_research
tools.description: One-call deep research across ALL sources: screener.in fundamentals + Yahoo Finance stats + multi-site news search (moneycontrol, ET, NSE, BSE). Returns ratios, pros/cons, quarterly results, peer table, shareholding, filings, news, and direct deep-links to screener.in, NSE, BSE, Yahoo Finance pages. Use for broad 'research', 'full analysis', or when user asks for comprehensive info about a stock from multiple sources.

aspects.description: Which aspects to fetch. Defaults to all.

tools.doc_summary: One-call deep research across all sources.

tools.name: compute_intraday_indicators
tools.description: Compute RSI, MACD, Supertrend, EMA, Bollinger, ATR, volume ratio, and a research setup score from PostgreSQL intraday.ohlcv_bars.
tools.doc_summary: Compute latest intraday indicators from PostgreSQL intraday OHLCV bars.

tools.name: deep_search
tools.description: Run a full deep-dive search on any NSE stock using up to 9 distinct parallel search verticals: NSE announcements, corporate actions, insider trades, BSE filings, shareholding analysis, analyst coverage, concall transcripts, sector news, social buzz. Intelligently selects verticals based on context (e.g. 'results' → concalls+announcements, 'dividend' → corporate_actions, 'insider' → insider_trades+shareholding). Use for 'deep search', 'deep dive', 'full search', or when multiple search verticals needed.

verticals.description: Specific verticals to run. Leave empty to auto-select from context.

context.description: Optional context hint to bias vertical selection (e.g. 'dividend ex-date', 'concall highlights', 'insider buying').

tools.doc_summary: Run multiple distinct search verticals in parallel for a comprehensive deep-dive on any NSE stock.

tools.name: delete_watchlist_alert
tools.description: Delete an alert by ID

tools.name: detect_non_symbol_terms
tools.description: Detect market or technical terms such as RSI, ADX, MA, MACD that must not be routed as stock symbols.
tools.doc_summary: Detect market/technical vocabulary that should not be resolved as tickers.

tools.name: discover_financial_filings
tools.description: Discover ranked latest-results filing candidates from NSE, BSE, and Screener for a symbol.
tools.doc_summary: Discover likely financial-result filings from NSE, BSE, and Screener.

tools.name: ensure_postgres_schema
tools.description: Idempotently create core Agent Adda PostgreSQL schemas/tables required by runtime tools.

tools.name: execute_plan
tools.description: Execute the latest Research Council plan from a serialized CouncilState.
tools.doc_summary: Execute the latest Research Council plan in a serialized state.

tools.name: explain_intraday_setup
tools.description: Explain a symbol's PostgreSQL-backed intraday setup using analyzer-style evidence, research-only labels LONG_SETUP/SHORT_SETUP/WATCH/AVOID/SETUP_INVALIDATED, technical target zones, and setup invalidation levels.
tools.doc_summary: Explain an intraday setup from PostgreSQL intraday bars with research-only labels.

tools.name: export_session
tools.description: Export the current research session to HTML or PDF report
tools.doc_summary: Export current session to HTML or PDF.

tools.name: fetch_article_content
tools.description: Fetch and read the full text of a news article from its URL. Use this to get deeper context from articles found via search tools when you need to provide a thorough summary and opinion.

url.description: Full URL of the article to fetch

tools.doc_summary: Fetch and extract readable text from a news article URL.

tools.name: fetch_pdf_text
tools.description: Download and extract text from a PDF at any URL — BSE financial results, annual reports, concall transcripts, SEBI filings, NSE circulars. Use whenever you have a direct PDF URL (e.g. from search_bse_filings, search_nse_announcements, or scrape_screener_in) and the user asks to read, summarise, or analyse the document contents. Returns page-by-page extracted text up to max_pages (default 15). Works on BSE/NSE hosted PDFs, screener.in transcript PDFs, and broker reports.

url.description: Direct URL to the PDF file

tools.doc_summary: Download a PDF from any URL and extract its text content using PyMuPDF.

tools.name: find_latest_report
tools.description: List available generated reports (HTML/CSV) by type keyword
tools.doc_summary: List available generated reports.

tools.name: find_portfolio_overlap
tools.description: Find portfolio holdings that also appear in a screener (stage2, supertrend_buy, all)
tools.doc_summary: Find portfolio holdings that also appear in a DB screener result.

tools.name: generate_portfolio_narratives
tools.description: P2-4 Portfolio Narrative Engine — per-stock investment narratives combining stage analysis, RSI, RS, signals, and fundamental snapshot. Returns bull thesis, bear case, and action hint for each stock. Use for: portfolio review, morning briefing narrative, stock-by-stock commentary, investment thesis validation, portfolio health check.

symbols.description: List of symbols to narrate. Default: top portfolio holdings.

top_n.description: Max number of stocks to narrate (default 5)

tools.doc_summary: P2-4 Portfolio Narrative Engine — per-stock LLM commentary combining technical, fundamental, and market context into a concise investment narrative.

tools.name: generate_report
tools.description: Generate a formatted report file (HTML, PDF, or Markdown) from analysis content. Use this after completing any analysis to save results as a professional report. Supports report types: technical, fundamental, forensic, research, intraday, canslim, ric, sector. The report is saved to reports/generated/ directory.

content.description: The full analysis content in Markdown format to include in the report

report_type.description: Type of report — determines styling and badge

symbol.description: Stock symbol or sector name for the report title

title.description: Custom report title (optional — auto-generated from type+symbol if omitted)

output_format.description: Output file format: html (styled), pdf (via weasyprint), or md (plain markdown)

filename.description: Custom filename without extension (optional — auto-generated if omitted)

tools.doc_summary: Generate a styled report file from analysis content.

tools.name: generate_voice_briefing
tools.description: P3-2 Voice Briefing — convert market summary to an MP3 audio briefing using OpenAI TTS. Auto-generates a 60-second daily market briefing if no text provided. Saves to data/voice_briefing.mp3. Requires OPENAI_API_KEY. Use for: hands-free morning briefing, audio market update, voice digest.

text.description: Custom text to convert. If None, auto-generates from market overview.

voice.description: TTS voice: alloy, echo, fable, onyx, nova, shimmer (default: alloy)

save_path.description: File path for MP3 output. Default: data/voice_briefing.mp3

tools.signature: (text: 'str | None' = None, voice: 'str' = 'cedar', save_path: 'str | None' = None) -> 'dict'
tools.doc_summary: P3-2 Daily Voice Briefing — convert market summary to audio using OpenAI GPT TTS.

tools.name: get_52week_extremes
tools.description: Find stocks nearest to their 52-week high or low in a given index. Use for '52-week high', '52-week low', 'new highs', 'new lows', 'near 52w high', 'breakout candidates', 'stocks at lows'. direction: 'high' or 'low'.
tools.doc_summary: Return stocks at their 52-week high or low.

tools.name: get_bulk_block_deals
tools.description: Fetch today's bulk deals (> 0.5% of shares) and block deals from NSE. Shows which institutional clients bought or sold large stakes. Use for 'bulk deals', 'block deals', 'institutional trades', 'large trades', 'who is buying'.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch today's bulk deals and block deals from NSE.

tools.name: get_chart_summary
tools.description: Get chart data and technical summary for a stock or index. Returns current price, daily change%, RSI(14), MACD signal (bullish/bearish), EMA20/EMA50 positions, period high/low. Use for: 'chart for X', 'technical levels', 'trend analysis', 'is X above its moving average', 'show me the chart', 'price action for X'.
tools.doc_summary: Get chart data summary for a symbol: current price, change%, RSI, MACD, EMA positions, period high/low, trend context. Does NOT render the ASCII chart — call render_chart() for that.

tools.name: get_company_evidence_coverage
tools.description: Report company evidence coverage counts and source gaps by category.

tools.name: get_company_insight
tools.description: Retrieve a pre-generated LLM analysis for a specific NSE stock from the company insights knowledge base. Use FIRST when the user asks 'explain', 'why', 'what drove', 'analyse' about a named stock's financials — e.g. 'explain AGARIND EPS growth', 'why did RELIANCE margins drop'. If the insight exists it is returned immediately without refetching data. If not found, call scrape_screener_in to fetch the data, analyse it, then call store_company_insight to persist for future queries.

insight_type.description: Type of insight (empty = return all recent insights)

tools.doc_summary: Retrieve a pre-generated LLM insight for a stock from scores.company_insights.

tools.name: get_composite_cost_of_carry
tools.description: Return cost-of-carry from the composite F&O wrapper.

tools.name: get_composite_futures_basis
tools.description: Return futures basis from the composite F&O wrapper.

tools.name: get_composite_max_pain
tools.description: Return max-pain summary from the composite option-chain wrapper.

tools.name: get_data_health
tools.description: Check freshness of all local data sources (CSV files, DB snapshots)
tools.doc_summary: Check freshness of all data sources.

tools.name: get_data_source_manifest
tools.description: Return Agent Adda's active data-source manifest, PostgreSQL primary-store policy, and fallback rules.

tools.name: get_economic_cycle_assessment
tools.description: B5 Economic Cycle Tracker — detect current macro cycle phase from proxy signals. Returns EARLY_EXPANSION / LATE_EXPANSION / SLOWDOWN / RECOVERY with confidence, preferred sectors to overweight, sectors to avoid, and full macro snapshot. Use for: macro-driven sector allocation, positioning in current cycle phase, understanding where we are in the business cycle, rate/inflation/commodity regime.
tools.doc_summary: B5 Economic Cycle Tracker — detect current macro cycle phase and sector positioning.

tools.name: get_eod_top_movers
tools.description: Get top EOD gainers/losers from the latest daily snapshot (`scores.stage_snapshots`). Use for 'top gainers EOD', 'top movers end of day', 'yesterday's top gainers', or any top-movers request when the agent is in historical mode. For LIVE intraday top movers use `get_top_gainers_losers` instead. Returns symbol, price, change_1d_pct, stage, RS, RSI, signal, sector.
tools.doc_summary: Return top EOD gainers and/or losers from the latest snapshot.

tools.name: get_event_calendar_summary
tools.description: Quick event calendar overview for an index — compact list of upcoming dividends, splits, bonuses, results announcements, and board meetings in the next N days. Lighter than get_upcoming_events. Use for: what events this week/fortnight, upcoming ex-dates, results season, event summary for NIFTY.
tools.doc_summary: Quick event calendar overview for an index — upcoming dividends, splits, bonuses, results, and board meetings in the next N days.

tools.name: get_fii_dii_activity
tools.description: Fetch today's FII (Foreign Institutional Investors) and DII (Domestic Institutional) buy/sell activity from NSE. Returns net buy/sell values in crores and sentiment. Use for 'FII', 'DII', 'institutional activity', 'foreign investors', 'FII buying/selling'.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch today's FII (Foreign Institutional Investors) and DII (Domestic) buy/sell activity from NSE. Returns net values in crores.

tools.name: get_fno_analytics
tools.description: PostgreSQL-backed F&O analytics for one symbol or top symbols. Returns PCR, max pain, max call/put OI strikes, futures OI/price change, buildup classification, and composite F&O signal. Use for: 'F&O analytics', 'FNO signal', 'long buildup', 'short buildup', 'max pain distance', 'top F&O bearish/bullish names'.
tools.doc_summary: Return PostgreSQL-backed F&O analytics: PCR, max pain, buildup, signal.

tools.name: get_fno_data_status
tools.description: Check status of local F&O EOD database: available dates and available strategy list. Use at the start of any F&O session to confirm data availability.
tools.doc_summary: Return the status of the local F&O EOD database: available dates, record counts, and last download time.

tools.name: get_fno_overview
tools.description: Composite F&O overview: option-chain PCR/max-pain/top OI, futures basis/carry, and a gated options-strategy recommendation.

tools.name: get_forthcoming_results
tools.description: Forthcoming results / earnings events from NSE event-calendar — companies with scheduled board meetings to declare quarterly financial results. Use for: 'results due this week', 'who is reporting tomorrow', 'upcoming earnings', 'forthcoming results', 'results calendar this week'. Returns symbol, company, scheduled date, purpose, board-meeting description; sorted earliest first.
tools.doc_summary: Forthcoming board meetings/events that will declare financial results.

tools.name: get_futures_analysis
tools.description: Futures chain analysis: basis (futures vs spot), cost of carry (annualised), rollover percentage, OI across expiries. Good for gauging institutional positioning. Use for: 'futures basis', 'cost of carry', 'rollover', 'futures premium/discount', 'long/short build-up in futures', 'what is NIFTY futures price'.
tools.doc_summary: Futures basis, cost-of-carry, and rollover analysis for an index or stock.

tools.name: get_global_market_assessment
tools.description: Assess global market cues for Indian markets from cached global index, FX, commodity, and correlation data. Returns risk regime, US/Asia/commodity/FX bias, India sector read-through, watch items, and Nifty correlation context. Use for global market assessment, overnight cues, US/Asia markets, crude, DXY, USDINR, and India read-through questions.
tools.doc_summary: Assess global market cues from cached global index and correlation files.

tools.name: get_index_snapshot
tools.description: Get the latest OHLCV and 10-day trend for a Nifty index
tools.doc_summary: Get latest index OHLCV and 10-day trend from index CSV.

tools.name: get_intraday_analysis
tools.description: Deep intraday technical analysis of a SINGLE NSE stock. Computes: MACD crossover, RSI reversal, Supertrend direction, Bollinger Band bounce, EMA 9/21 crossover, VCP pattern, Volume spike signals — each with entry price, target, stop-loss, and Risk:Reward ratio. Also returns key support/resistance levels (pivot points, swing highs/lows, EMAs), full indicator readings, and overall bias. Use for: 'intraday setup for X', 'should I buy X today', 'entry target SL for X', 'technical signals X', 'trading strategy for X'.

strategies.description: Strategies to run. Default is all.

tools.doc_summary: Deep intraday analysis of a single stock.

tools.name: get_intraday_bars
tools.description: Read OHLCV bars from PostgreSQL intraday.ohlcv_bars for one symbol and timeframe. When PG has no bars, seed PG from yfinance candles and return source metadata.
tools.doc_summary: Read intraday OHLCV bars from PostgreSQL, seeding PG from yfinance if needed.

tools.name: get_intraday_levels
tools.description: Compute support, resistance, pivot, EMA, and latest close levels from PostgreSQL intraday.ohlcv_bars. Technical levels only; not a trade recommendation.
tools.doc_summary: Compute support/resistance levels from PostgreSQL intraday OHLCV bars.

tools.name: get_intraday_market_recap
tools.description: Summarize what changed in the live market over the last N minutes. Compares current NSE live index tape with stored intraday snapshots when available; otherwise returns the current live tape with a snapshot-only note. Use for: 'what happened in the last 15 minutes', 'last 30 min market recap', 'what changed just now'.
tools.doc_summary: Summarize what changed in the broad market over the last N minutes.

tools.name: get_intraday_source_health
tools.description: Check PostgreSQL intraday source health. Reports whether intraday.quote_snapshots, intraday.ohlcv_bars, and related tables exist, row counts, latest timestamps, freshness, and overall intraday status. Use before intraday calculations.
tools.doc_summary: Report health of PostgreSQL intraday source tables.

tools.name: get_last_report
tools.description: Return the last generated report path/context, or request clarification if none is remembered.
tools.signature: (last_report_path: 'str | Path | None' = None, project_root: 'str | Path | None' = None) -> 'dict[str, Any]'

tools.name: get_latest_results
tools.description: High-level latest-results evidence pack for a symbol: discovery, ingestion, parsing, reconciliation, missing facts, and source trail.
tools.doc_summary: Build the latest-results evidence pack for one symbol.

tools.name: get_latest_results_feed
tools.description: Market-wide feed of companies that have just declared quarterly financial results across NSE. Pulls NSE corporates-financial-results JSON (cached 30 min) with screener.in /results/latest fallback. Use for: 'latest results', 'who reported today', 'results this week', 'companies that announced results', 'results posted recently'. Do NOT use when the user names a specific symbol — use stock_results path instead.
tools.doc_summary: Market-wide feed of companies that have filed quarterly financial results.

tools.name: get_live_market_overview
tools.description: Fetch live NSE index levels (Nifty 50, Bank Nifty, IT, Midcap, Smallcap) plus advances/declines. Use for 'how is the market', 'market today', 'live market' queries.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch live NSE index values (broad-market + sectoral) plus advances/declines.

tools.name: get_live_quote
tools.description: Fetch live NSE price for a single stock — returns last price, VWAP, day OHLC, % change, volume, traded value, 52w high/low with dates, circuit limits (upper/lower), sector P/E, stock P/E, and exact NSE last-update timestamp. First-class NSE real-time data — no lag. Use for: 'current price of X', 'live quote', 'what is X trading at', 'show me X price'.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch live intraday quote for a single NSE symbol from the NSE API.

tools.name: get_long_term_growth_candidates
tools.description: Rank live NSE index constituents for long-term growth research using PostgreSQL technical/fundamental scores and optional screener.in enrichment. Use for prompts asking for long-term growth-potential stocks in midcap/smallcap/index universes.
tools.doc_summary: Rank index constituents for long-term growth research using DB evidence.

tools.name: get_market_breadth
tools.description: Get overall NSE market breadth: advance/decline, RS distribution, stage breakdown
tools.doc_summary: Compute market breadth: A/D ratio, %>200MA, sector overview.

tools.name: get_most_active_stocks
tools.description: Get the most actively traded stocks by volume or traded value from an NSE index. Use for 'most active', 'highest volume', 'most traded', 'activity leaders'. 'by' can be 'volume' or 'value'.
tools.doc_summary: Return most actively traded stocks by volume or traded value.

tools.name: get_nse_intraday_snapshot
tools.description: Fetch the NSE website live quote/index snapshot before any yfinance intraday fallback. For stocks this calls NSE quote-equity; for indices such as NIFTY50/BANKNIFTY it calls NSE allIndices. If NSE blocks stock quotes, returns a degraded yfinance intraday-candle snapshot with fallback_reason. NSE website APIs provide live snapshot fields, not full candle history.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch the NSE website live snapshot before any yfinance intraday fallback.

tools.name: get_nse_quotes
tools.description: Fetch live NSE prices for MULTIPLE stocks in parallel — returns last price, VWAP, % change, volume, circuit limits, and sector P/E for all symbols at once. Much faster than calling get_live_quote() individually. Use for: 'prices of RELIANCE, TCS, INFY', 'check my watchlist prices', 'how are these stocks doing: X Y Z', 'batch price check'.

symbols.description: List of NSE tickers, up to 20

tools.doc_summary: Fetch live NSE prices for multiple symbols in parallel.

tools.name: get_oi_analysis
tools.description: Focused open interest analysis: PCR, max pain, top CE/PE OI concentration strikes, OI buildup and unwinding. Identifies key support (PE OI) and resistance (CE OI) levels. Use for: 'where is support/resistance', 'OI buildup', 'PCR signal', 'max pain level', 'where is call writing', 'where is put writing'.
tools.doc_summary: Focused open-interest analysis: PCR, max pain, CE/PE OI concentration, OI buildup and unwinding at key strikes. Good for support/resistance.

tools.name: get_option_chain
tools.description: Fetch live option chain for a NIFTY/BANKNIFTY index or any NSE stock. Returns: underlying price, PCR (put-call ratio), max pain, top CE/PE OI strikes (key resistance/support), ATM±2 greeks (delta/theta/vega/gamma/IV), OI buildup and unwinding, IV skew, DTE. Falls back to EOD data outside market hours. Use for: 'option chain', 'OI analysis', 'PCR', 'max pain', 'support resistance', 'greeks', 'IV', 'option data for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/<stock>'.

symbol.description: NSE symbol e.g. NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, RELIANCE

expiry.description: Expiry date YYYY-MM-DD or NSE format e.g. 08-May-2026

tools.doc_summary: Fetch live option chain for an index or stock. Returns OI, IV, PCR, max pain, ATM greeks, OI buildup and support/resistance levels. Falls back to EOD data outside market hours.

tools.name: get_option_chain_summary
tools.description: Summarize option-chain PCR, max pain, and top OI strikes for an index/equity.

tools.name: get_options_chain
tools.description: Fetch live NSE options chain with full OI, IV, LTP, PCR, and max pain. Returns side-by-side calls/puts data for all strikes near ATM, total OI, PCR (put-call ratio), max pain strike, and available expiry dates. Use for: 'options chain', 'OI buildup', 'PCR', 'max pain', 'IV skew', 'option chain for NIFTY/BANKNIFTY/<stock>', 'show me calls and puts'.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch NSE options chain for a symbol with PCR, max pain, and IV data.

tools.name: get_options_strategy
tools.description: Build a specific options strategy with live pricing. Returns legs, strikes, entry costs, max risk, max reward, breakeven points, and payoff curve. Data from screener.in annual balance sheet + P&L + cash flow statements. tools.description: Search for mutual fund holdings and FII/DII institutional ownership data for a stock. Combines screener.in direct shareholding scrape (promoter/FII/DII quarterly trend) with web search across Trendlyne, Moneycontrol, Tijori Finance. Use for: MF holdings, institutional ownership, FII activity, DII buying/selling, promoter pledge, shareholding pattern changes.
tools.doc_summary: Search for mutual fund and FII/DII institutional holding data.

tools.name: search_nse_announcements
tools.description: Fetch live NSE corporate announcements for a stock (board meetings, results filings, regulatory disclosures, pledging changes). Source: nseindia.com live API. Use when user asks about 'NSE announcements', 'latest filings', 'company disclosures'.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch recent corporate announcements/filings for a stock.

tools.name: search_sector_news
tools.description: Aggregate sector-level news from 6 portals in parallel: Economic Times, Business Standard, Mint, Moneycontrol, Financial Express, Hindu BusinessLine. Use when user asks about 'sector news', 'industry news', 'latest news', or for macro sector context around a stock.
tools.doc_summary: Aggregate sector-level news and macro context from 6 distinct portals.

tools.name: search_shareholding_analysis
tools.description: Scrape quarterly shareholding pattern from screener.in: promoter %, FII %, DII %, public %, pledge alerts, and QoQ change trends. Use when user asks about 'shareholding', 'promoter holding', 'FII holding', 'pledge', 'DII activity'.
tools.doc_summary: Scrape quarterly shareholding pattern trends for a stock from screener.in.

tools.name: search_social_buzz
tools.description: Gauge retail investor sentiment from Indian investing communities: Reddit r/IndiaInvestments, r/IndianStockMarket, Valuepickr, Traderji, Tijori. Returns community discussions plus a rough bullish/bearish sentiment signal. Use when user asks about 'social sentiment', 'retail view', 'community buzz', 'what are investors saying about X'.
tools.doc_summary: Gauge retail investor sentiment from Indian investing communities and forums.

tools.name: search_yahoo_finance
tools.description: Fetch Yahoo Finance data for an NSE stock: current price stats (52-week range, day range, prev close) and up to 6 recent news articles with real URLs. Use for 'yahoo finance', 'YF news', 'latest news', or as a supplementary news source alongside search_latest_catalysts.
tools.doc_summary: Fetch from Yahoo Finance: • current price, 52-week range, day range, volume (chart API) • up to 6 news articles with real URLs (search API) NSE symbols use the .NS suffix (e.g. TCS.NS).

tools.name: store_company_insight
tools.description: Persist an LLM-generated fundamental analysis for an NSE stock into the company insights knowledge base so it can be retrieved instantly in future sessions. Call after analysing quarterly/annual data. Required fields: symbol, insight_type, question (the user's question), answer (full analysis). Optional: evidence dict of key numbers used, source_date.
tools.signature: (symbol: 'str', insight_type: 'str', question: 'str', answer: 'str', evidence: 'dict | None' = None, source_date: 'str' = '') -> 'dict'
tools.doc_summary: Persist an LLM-generated insight for a stock into scores.company_insights KB.

tools.name: summarize_latest_results
tools.description: Summarize a latest-results evidence pack without inventing missing revenue/PAT/EPS facts.
tools.doc_summary: Summarize a latest-results evidence pack without filling missing numbers.

tools.name: summarize_report
tools.description: Summarize an existing report while preserving symbol, report type, recommendation, and source path.

tools.name: synthesize_council_decision
tools.description: Synthesize the final Research Council decision from findings, branch summaries, plan results, and critic reviews.
tools.doc_summary: Synthesize the final Research Council decision from findings and reviews.

tools.name: validate_answer_against_evidence
tools.description: Validate rendered answer text against available evidence categories and report unsupported claim categories.
tools.doc_summary: Detect obvious unsupported claim categories in a rendered answer.

tools.name: validate_intent_evidence_plan
tools.description: Validate a planned evidence-tool list against required tools for an intent.
tools.signature: (intent: 'str', evidence_plan: 'list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None' = None, required_tools: 'list[str] | tuple[str, ...] | None' = None) -> 'dict'
tools.doc_summary: Validate that an assessment/tool plan covers the required evidence tools.

tools.name: validate_requested_symbols
tools.description: Validate explicit ticker-looking symbols requested by the user against symbols used in executed evidence, ignoring indicators like RSI/ADX/MA.
tools.doc_summary: Compare explicit ticker-looking user tokens against executed evidence symbols.

tools.name: validate_required_tools_executed
tools.description: Validate that all required evidence tools executed for a planned intent.

tools.name: validate_strength_watchlist
tools.description: Data-direct validator for ranking a list of NSE stocks by CANSLIM score, relative strength, enhanced fundamental score, Piotroski F-score, Beneish, and Altman. Never assumes missing evidence: missing CANSLIM, RS, fundamental, or forensic data is returned in missing_evidence and evidence_coverage.

symbols.description: NSE symbols to validate and rank

tools.doc_summary: Validate CANSLIM/RS/fundamental/Piotroski strength from auditable sources.
